contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Game concept and detailed mission specification (shop on a floating market, ten days, forecast-driven buying, fresh-goods decay, one shop upgrade, validation criteria), directed as part of the Z Code game workshop.

contributions.name: Z Code
contributions.summary: Designed the economy and implemented the whole game: deterministic seeded engine, six customer profiles, freshness and FIFO pricing with visible arithmetic, trilingual interface (EN/FR/ES), inline-SVG art and synthesized audio; balanced it with a 600-seed strategy simulator and verified the rules with headless tests plus real browser play sessions.
